question: How does will relate to knowledge and action in this sequence?
premises: The sequence runs from the unsurpassed to the power of knowledge.
Will itself is established in that process.
Will, together with lordship, is established in relation to the power of action.
inference: Within the sequence from the unsurpassed to knowledge, will becomes established as the link to action through lordship.
plain_english: Beginning from the unsurpassed and extending to the power of knowledge, will itself is established, and together with lordship it is established in relation to the power of action.
